title: MIMIC-Ext-Stroke
summary: A research pipeline that builds privacy-preserving synthetic stroke-patient digital twins from MIMIC-IV ICU data, combining a Bayesian network for static profiles with a DoppelGANger time-series model, evaluated against fidelity, utility, and privacy metrics. SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer are imported and fit as baseline single-table generators compared against the paper's hybrid digital-twin model.
evidence: src/models/ctgan_baseline.py:11-12 `from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer`; scripts/run_full_evaluation.py:459-479 fits CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer as baselines
